scenario.name: XT workstation - Production 230XP22B layout (illustrative)
scenario.description: Dynamic subsea producer arranged as on the reference control-system page 'Production 230XP22B': production bore with SCSSV, PMV and the production wing (PWV) ending in the production choke PCV3006; A-annulus with AMV, AWV, crossover XOV into the tree cavity and the annulus service line valve SLV; chemical injection into the production wing; two methanol injection valves either side of PWV; downhole chemical injection; SCM A/B hydraulic headers with selector valves (fail-safe closure on loss of supply). The photograph defines the ARCHITECTURE only: every reading is calculated by the simulator from the configured reservoir, fluid, boundary and valve inputs. All data are ILLUSTRATIVE training values.

briefing: This page reproduces the reference control-system layout 'Production 230XP22B'. Tags are the reference numbers; open a component to see its SubseaSim engineering tag.

Every reading is calculated by the simulator from the inputs on the Conditions page (reservoir pressure, temperature, productivity, fluid, downstream pressure) and the valve positions - change them and watch the transmitters respond.
Try closing PWV3005: the tree cavity (PTT3005 / PTT3004) builds toward shut-in pressure while the choke outlet (PTT3008 / PTT3009) falls toward flowline pressure.
Selector valves route the LP and HP hydraulic supplies to SCM A and B. Close both LP selector valves and watch LP3096 / LP3097 bleed down until the fail-safe valves close.
Open MIV3015 (upstream of PWV) or MIV3016 (between PWV and the choke) to inject methanol into the production stream; the concentration is tracked downstream.

reference.source: User-supplied photograph of a subsea control-system page 'Production 230XP22B without IWC' (810 x 1080 px).
reference.method: Component centres and panel boxes measured in photo pixels, keystone-straightened (verticals made vertical, measured shear ~0.07 px/px), then scaled uniformly. Relative positions are preserved; text panels are enlarged slightly for legibility around the same anchor.
notes: Tags PT3010, PT3011 and PT3013 (listed in the requirement) could not be located on the photograph and are not assigned.
The SCM Reconnect button on the reference is not reproduced: SCM communications are not modelled.
Chemical names at the right-hand line ends are illegible on the photograph; SubseaSim chemical names are shown.
The framed region right of photo x = 550 (manifold, additional transmitters) is a SubseaSim addition outside the reference page.

integrity_presets.name: PMV inflow (leak-off) test - tree cavity
integrity_presets.description: Close PMV, bleed the cavity to flowline pressure through PWV, close PWV, then monitor PT-104 for build-up from tubing pressure across the closed PMV.

integrity_presets.name: Tree cavity pressure-hold test (MeOH pressurised)
integrity_presets.description: With PMV, PWV and SV closed, pressurise the cavity with methanol (open CIV-301), close CIV-301, then monitor PT-104 for decay across the PMV / PWV / SV seats.

integrity_presets.name: Swab valve inflow test - tree cap
integrity_presets.description: With SV-101 closed and the tree bore at production pressure, monitor the tree cap (PT-105) for build-up across the closed swab valve.

integrity_presets.name: AMV inflow test - annulus cavity
integrity_presets.description: Close AMV, bleed the AMV-AWV cavity through AWV and SLV, close AWV and monitor PT-402.

model.hydraulics: DYNAMIC: lumped compressible network - node mass balance C dP/dt = sum Q + V beta dT/dt, link momentum I dQ/dt = dP - rho g dz - R(Q); compliance from liquid compressibility + pipe-wall elasticity (Korteweg); implicit Euler + Newton on a fixed step. Pressure waves are represented only approximately (step >> acoustic transit time of a segment).
model.reservoir: Radial single-phase diffusion on a logarithmic grid with a constant-pressure outer boundary; kh derived from the productivity index so the final steady state equals the linear IPR.
model.transport: Chemical volume fractions and temperature advected by the calculated link flows (finite volume, upwind, sub-cycled). Numerical dispersion only (no Taylor dispersion term).
model.thermal: Cell energy balance with heat loss to ambient, isenthalpic throttling, enthalpy mixing of injected chemicals; fluid heat capacity only (pipe-wall/tree-body thermal mass neglected). Annulus: lumped temperature.
model.valves: Dead time + rate-limited travel (separate open/close times); seat leakage when closed; check valves with cracking pressure.
model.instruments: First-order sensor lag, update interval and resolution applied to the modelled process value.

steady_reference.note: Algebraic steady operating point of the production path for the CURRENT valve positions and boundaries (excludes injection streams). The dynamic state relaxes toward it.
